native.1: FuzeVPN is installed, but its service did not confirm that it restarted. Run the installation again to repair the application.
native.2: Unable to verify the Windows version or architecture. See the installation log.
native.4: This installer requires Windows {Architecture}. Choose the package that matches your computer.
native.5: Windows Installer rollback must be enabled before any FuzeVPN maintenance operation.
native.6: Choose an absolute local folder to install FuzeVPN.
native.7: A newer version is already installed, or its version cannot be verified.
native.9: The version or folder check failed.
native.10: The VPN did not confirm that it stopped. Installation was interrupted without replacing the files.
native.11: Close FuzeVPN and its update assistant, then run the installation again. No process was force-terminated.
native.12: The VPN could not be stopped safely.
native.13: Maintenance cannot be completed. Run the installation again to repair FuzeVPN.
native.14: Rollback is still blocked by maintenance; run the installation again to repair.
theme.SuccessOpenApp: Open FuzeVPN from the Start menu. Your personal preferences have been preserved.
